description: cosechat interop vectors: every entry must verify / decrypt to `expect`

reject.name: tampered
reject.rule: AEAD tag must verify

reject.name: forwarded to a third party
reject.rule: reject unless our address is in the signed `to`

reject.name: unknown sender
reject.rule: sender keyset must be known or attached

reject.name: sealed to a ratchet we do not hold
reject.rule: the kid must name one of our ratchets

reject.name: signature kid names someone else
reject.rule: the signature must verify with the kid identity keys

reject.name: pre-quantum sender under the default policy
reject.rule: quantum_safe_only drops non-quantum-safe senders

reject.name: tampered
reject.rule: signature must verify

reject.name: for another address
reject.rule: keyset must hash to dest

reject.name: older sequence
reject.rule: ignore a lower sequence than the last accepted

reject.name: short announce checked against another keyset
reject.rule: a short announce verifies only with the keyset that hashes to its address

reject.name: short announce, keyset unknown
reject.rule: fetch the keyset first

reject.name: ratchet with a wrong kid
reject.rule: an announced ratchet is a public HPKE key carrying its own id

reject.name: ratchet that is not a KEM key
reject.rule: an announced ratchet is a public HPKE key carrying its own id

reject.name: ratchet carrying its private key
reject.rule: an announced ratchet is a public HPKE key carrying its own id

reject.name: announce without a ratchet
reject.rule: an announce must carry a ratchet

reject.name: future protocol version
reject.rule: drop malformed frames

reject.name: unknown packet type
reject.rule: drop malformed frames

reject.name: short address
reject.rule: drop malformed frames

reject.name: link request for someone else
reject.rule: a request must name us as the peer

reject.name: accept for a different request
reject.rule: the accept is bound to SHA-256(request)

reject.name: frame under another road key
reject.rule: drop frames that fail road auth
